name: web-warm-cream-saas-curved-portrait-carousel
title: Cream SaaS landing with a curved portrait carousel hero
whatItIs: A cream landing page for a workflow tool. A serif line sits above a bold sans headline and a black CTA. Below, a row of portraits is bent in perspective like a curved wall, followed by a bento grid of rounded cards in beige, olive and tan mixing photos and text.
whatItMeans: Warm, human and organised; earthy tones feel less corporate than usual SaaS blue.
techniques: Combine a light serif phrase with a heavy sans phrase in one headline for contrast.
Warp a photo row in perspective to make a flat page feel three-dimensional.
Build feature blocks as a bento grid of soft rounded rectangles in muted earth tones.
Overlay white text on photo tiles with a gentle gradient for legibility.
bestFor: Service platforms with real customer faces

vocabulary.definition: A layout of rounded tiles of different sizes, like a lunchbox.
An image row angled to appear curved.
Beige, olive, clay and brown tones.
Mixing serif and sans within one heading.
